# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security problems privately, not in a public issue or pull request.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting:
<https://github.com/ideaSquared/ideasquared-website/security/advisories/new>

Include the page or URL, what you did, what happened, and what you expected. A screenshot or a short
proof of concept helps.

## What to expect

- We acknowledge a report within 5 working days.
- We tell you whether we consider it a vulnerability, and what we plan to do, within 15 working days.
- We fix confirmed issues as soon as we reasonably can and credit you in the advisory if you want that.
- Please give us a reasonable chance to fix the problem before you disclose it publicly.

## Scope

This repository is the static ideaSquared studio site (HTML, CSS and a little JavaScript). It has no
accounts, forms, database or server code, and it sets no cookies. Reports about missing or weak response
headers, content injection and anything that could expose a visitor to harm are in scope. The ventures
the site links to (AdoptDontShop, Pairflix, CreatrGrid) are separate products with their own repositories.
